title: CBC/Radio-Canada reveals PWHL broadcast schedule, including return of Hockey Night in Canada
summary: CBC/Radio-Canada unveiled its broadcast schedule Friday for the upcoming Professional Women’s Hockey League season, which features more games on the network than ever before.

blocks.text: CBC/Radio-Canada unveiled its broadcast schedule Friday for the upcoming Professional Women’s Hockey League season, which features more games on the network than ever before.
26 games will air on CBC this season, 8 will feature on Hockey Night in Canada
CBC/Radio-Canada unveiled its broadcast schedule Friday for the upcoming PWHL season, which features more games on the network than ever before.

A total of 26 matchups will be available on CBC TV and CBC Gem, including eight Hockey Night in Canada primetime games on Saturday nights. Earlier this week, CBC announced that Hockey Night in Canada will return in partnership with the PWHL for its 90th season on CBC.

items: CBC/Radio-Canada announces return of Hockey Night in Canada in PWHL partnership

blocks.text: Coverage begins with the PWHL's season-opening game between the Vancouver Goldeneyes and Seattle Torrent on Saturday, Dec. 5 at 3 p.m. ET.
Hockey Night in Canada returns with the PWHL

The action continues at 7 p.m. ET when the first-ever women’s hockey game will be featured on CBC’s Hockey Night in Canada. That game features the reigning Walter Cup champion Montréal Victoire hosting PWHL Hamilton.
